'''Camooine''' was a terrestrial [[Planet/Legends|planet]] with three [[Moon/Legends|moons]] that occupied the third [[Orbit/Legends|orbital]] position around the [[Star/Legends|star]] [[Dina/Legends|Dina]]. It was located in the [[Dantooine system/Legends|Dantooine system]], a part of the [[Raioballo sector/Legends|Raioballo sector]] in the [[New Territories/Legends|New Territories]] portion of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. Along with the rest of its [[Star system/Legends|star system]], Camooine was situated at the endpoint of the [[Myto's Arrow/Legends|Myto's Arrow]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperspace route]], which linked it to the [[Angor system/Legends|Angor system]], while the [[Veragi Trade Route/Legends|Veragi Trade Route]] connected it to the [[Ahakista system/Legends|Ahakista]] and [[Sinsang system/Legends|Sinsang systems]].<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
Camooine was mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', authored by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square L-4.<ref name="TEA" />
